name: Little Romance
description:
The character is based on a photographic self-portrait of the young Shortcut, in which he expressed his love for music.

He used it to illustrate one of his short-stories called 'Little Romance', in which he reflects on the love of a musician to his instrument.

Like in music, love is a lot about rhythm, timing and harmonies.
